Built for the journey — and the passenger.

Both vehicles share the Green SM technology platform, climate comfort and core passenger amenities. Their interiors are configured differently to serve their respective customer segments.

Transparent pricing

Simple fares. Clear difference.

Both segments share the same base, traffic-delay and waiting charges. Elite has a higher per-kilometre rate to reflect its additional space and accessibility configuration.

ChargeGreen SM GoGreen SM Elite
Base fareAED 12AED 12
Per kilometreAED 1.85/kmAED 2.00/km
Traffic delayAED 0.85/minAED 0.85/min
Waiting after first 4 minutesAED 0.65/minAED 0.65/min
10 km example: Green SM Go = AED 30.50 · Green SM Elite = AED 32.00, before traffic delay or additional waiting charges.
Shared technology

One connected platform behind both segments.

Green SM Go and Green SM Elite operate through the same digital ecosystem, keeping the passenger experience connected from booking through payment.

MDT — Taxi Operating SystemBooking → Dispatch → Navigation → Taxi Meter → Payment → Fleet Management.
